description: Pair actual face diagonal XZ and body diagonal XA by the same red dashed style, targeting transfer of the explicitly given sqrt(55) from XZ to XA. Both share X but have different named endpoints. The purpose is face/body edge correspondence, with all labels and original hidden dashes retained.
